name: Views Filter Last Delta
description: Filter by the last delta value of a multiple value field.
project_description:
The last delta (value) of a multi-value field bears unique importance. It is the last piece of information written in a field and it is often the only information required to be shown on an Entity View.

 Views itself provide two modes of viewing a multi-value field:

 
 All the values on the same row; 
 Each value is on an individual row. 
 
 If you want to output just the last row, containing the last value of the field, this filter is for you.

 Usage 
 Enable this module as usual, untick the ‘Display all values in the same row’ tickbox in the field setting inside the Views’ fields, add a Filter in the category Last Delta corresponding to that field, and enable filtering by selecting ‘Yes’.
